persistence.result: pass at the narrow extension scope
persistence.basis: Existing code-led game world; no approved comp, PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, QUALITY BAR card or full five-block direction contract was supplied. The calling brief explicitly scopes this as an extension of the established night palette, current HUD and Plex KR Regular 400. No new visual-world approval or comp phase is implied.
persistence.evidence: All 16 required original captures opened individually, correct dimensions/corners and usable render states; their hashes match after-captures.json and its source hash matches public/version.json. South-east is native movement from m4 start; the other three corners are controlled edge fixtures followed by native movement, not playthroughs.

matrix.evidence: The supplied renders retain the established compact Korean HUD typography and hierarchy. Font files/computed font resolution were not independently measured.

src/js/graphics/world_border.js uses the existing kit asphalt, wall and concrete textures with bounded cached canvas roof/wall tiles; the final originals visibly render textured roofs, vents, parapets and physical perimeter walls in the game's existing pixel world.

The exterior is a muted green night street surface, legible beside the dark playable streets across all four viewport classes. The 16 originals show no black off-map void. Exact color matching has no approved comp authority here.

All four corner groups visibly place a continuous physical wall immediately outside the playable edge. world_border.js clips exterior scenery outside [0,MW*TILE] x [0,MH*TILE]; render/frame.js draws it after playable darkness. No grid or collider expansion is introduced by this renderer.
Neighboring roofs and streets continue beyond the wall with no action markers, doors offered as controls, NPCs or target labels. Scenery is drawn only and does not register gameplay entities.

Actor silhouette remains recognizable at every corner on PC, portrait, landscape and small screens. Mobile action controls remain below the actor. At south-west PC the thin keyboard legend crosses the feet/lower legs, but does not conceal the body or obscure the direction of the visible boundary; this is below a material blocker.

interaction/recovery_input.js accepts the committed exact corpse only in the final .25 seconds, executes it once after actionBusy clears, and cancels on movement, damage, position/floor/height changes, expiration or missing/stashed/carried body. 90_input.js clears it on input reset. production-recovery.json reports six controlled cases passed on keyboard and touch.

matrix.element: Reachable AI destination and physical post avoidance
matrix.evidence: ai/navigation.js sets pathGoal to an actually reachable neighboring cell for a solid observation while preserving lastSeen. Street-post detours validate sampled physical legs. mechanics.json records three blocked inspections and four real street-post pursuit fixtures, including repeated replanning, arriving without memory changes.

fidelity.validation: The existing single detector result is []; it was not rerun. /tmp/tests-v158.log ends with all tests passing. campaign-journey.json records native keyboard/touch entry encounter, KO/carry, foliage storage and checkpoint menu restore with live actors.
fidelity.limits: Static render review plus source and existing test-evidence inspection. No independent browser session, complete contract playthrough, every combat branch, or whole-game guarantee. The boundary render probes are controlled fixtures; campaign journey covers the entry flow only.

ceiling.basis: The new perimeter uses the established game's native devices: tiled material, wall posts, gates, curb continuation, roof fixtures and restrained night depth. Further ornament, exterior inhabitants or interactive-looking detail would dilute the separation between playable town and scenery. No material ambition gap requires another polish round.

keep: Keep the existing night town, current HUD and Plex KR Regular 400; keep all m2/m4/m6 playable grids, detection and skills intact, the explicit wall/scenery distinction, exact-victim cleanup cancellation, reachable AI goals and bounded exterior cache.
